import sys


def main():
    jobs = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split()
        name, arrival, duration, priority = parts[0], int(parts[1]), int(parts[2]), int(parts[3])
        jobs.append((name, arrival, duration, priority))

    # Sort jobs by priority descending, then by arrival time ascending,
    # then by name ascending
    jobs.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[3], x[1], x[0]))

    time = 0
    idle = 0
    job_index = 0

    while job_index < len(jobs):
        current_job = jobs[job_index]

        if current_job[1] > time:
            idle += current_job[1] - time
            time = current_job[1]

        print(f"{current_job[0]} {time} {time + current_job[2]}")

        time += current_job[2]

        job_index += 1

    print(f"idle {idle}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
